hook: Researchers rewrite an AI-generated proof of the Falconer distance conjecture for graduate readers.
summary: This note presents a simplified version of a proof of the Falconer distance conjecture, whose main idea the authors took from a recent OpenAI release. It rewrites the arguments for graduate-level readers. The abstract gives no technical detail, and correctness depends on the underlying AI-produced proof and on community checking, so the claim is unverified here.
title: On the proof of Falconer distance conjecture
